findings: In `meaning_history.senses[0]` and its generated `meaning:木:tree` edge, remove the claim that the reported oracle-bone phrase does not confirm a historical tree-related use. The cited evidence reports 《合集》5749「埶(藝)木」 as planting trees and identifies ‘tree’ as the original sense (X-c968eea23b72eeb177f0, X-86ca99f1ed28a3fe2c1e, X-7e38f1d40f1d9ce9d3cc). Describe this as a source-reported early use, retaining the qualification that the rubbing was not inspected; do not label it `earliest_attested` or imply it predates the wood/board use, whose relative chronology is unresolved (X-39e70d0fed13fe85a6e8, X-87863282d25f5c4271ea).
